title: scleria centralis
intro: Scleria centralis, commonly known as Scleria, is a type of sedge plant native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Scleria centralis include antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antifungal properties, contributing to its potential in managing oxidative stress, diabetes, and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of Scleria centralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
